record.one_liner: Help desk and live chat software with ticketing, call center, and knowledge base for customer support teams.
record.auth_notes: The core REST API v3 uses a per-account apikey parameter passed on every request. The separate built-in MCP server supports either a manually-generated bearer access token (up to 10 tokens/account, 2-year expiry) or OAuth 2.1 with automatic authorization-server discovery.
record.access_notes: Signup is self-serve via a 30-day free trial requiring no credit card; API access (with a quota of API keys: 1 on Small up to 100 on Enterprise) is included in every paid subscription tier without extra cost.
record.api_breadth_basis: API v3 reference covers multiple resource families (agents, companies, conversations/tickets, customers, departments, knowledge base, reports) with CRUD-style endpoints per family — more than a narrow single-resource API but not an exhaustive broad platform surface.
record.blocker_notes: Full API and account functionality require a subscription (trial available with no credit card for 30 days, then a paid plan); no separate approval or partnership gate was found for API or MCP access.
